summary: A builtin workflow definition a release shipped is immutable at its version: a content change ships as a new version in the same release, the registry compiles every released version so a pin on any of them verifies forever, and workflow_definition_version_pins_test.go pins every registered digest so an in-place edit fails before release. The mechanism shipped in #863; this record makes the discipline law.
title: A released workflow definition never changes content in place
